translations.web: He commanded them, saying, “You shall do this in the fear of Yahweh, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
translations.bsb: He commanded them, saying, “You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the LORD.
translations.kjv: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of the LORD, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
translations.asv: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall ye do in the fear of Jehovah, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
